canonical_statement: The FUTURE trial evaluated the efficacy and safety of subtype- and genomic biomarker-guided precision treatments in heavily pretreated patients with refractory metastatic triple-negative breast cancer.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of multiple precision treatments in heavily pretreated patients with refractory metastatic TNBC who had received a median of three previous lines of therapy.

canonical_statement: FUTURE was a phase Ib/II, open-label umbrella trial in refractory metastatic TNBC, registered as NCT03805399.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The FUTURE trial is a phase Ib/II, open-label, umbrella trial evaluating the efficacy and safety of multiple targeted treatments based on tumor characteristics of patients with refractory metastatic TNBC.

canonical_statement: The trial enrolled 69 patients with refractory metastatic TNBC from 87 screened patients; the median number of previous metastatic antitumor regimens was three (range 1–8).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Between October 18th, 2018 and March 25th, 2020, 69 patients were enrolled in the FUTURE trial, out of 87 screened patients.

canonical_statement: Eligible patients were female patients with pathologically diagnosed TNBC, ECOG performance status 0–2, and at least one target lesion; uncontrolled brain metastases were excluded.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We enrolled female patients with pathologically diagnosed TNBC ... ECOG performance status 0–2 ... at least one target lesion ... patients with uncontrolled brain metastases were excluded.

population.label: Eligibility population
inclusion_criteria: Female patient with pathologically diagnosed TNBC

canonical_statement: Each enrolled patient underwent biopsy of a recurrent/metastatic lesion for IHC subtyping and targeted sequencing; the sequencing panel contained 484 cancer-related genes.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: each enrolled patient underwent baseline biopsy for the IHC subtyping and genomic biomarker screening... This panel included 484 cancer-related genes.

canonical_statement: IHC-based subtype assignment used AR, CD8, and FOXC1; supplementary methods report positivity cutoffs of at least 10% for AR and FOXC1 and at least 20% for CD8.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: cutoff values of AR and FOXC1 were determined as 10% ... cutoff value of CD8 was determined as 20%.

canonical_statement: The primary endpoint was objective response rate after two cycles; secondary endpoints included disease control rate, progression-free survival, overall survival, and safety.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The primary end point of the FUTURE trial was the ORR after two cycles. The secondary end point included DCR, progression-free survival (PFS), overall survival (OS) and safety.

canonical_statement: ITT comprised all enrolled patients; PP excluded patients without at least one post-baseline efficacy evaluation. ORR and DCR 95% CIs used Clopper–Pearson; PFS/OS used Kaplan–Meier.

The ORR and DCR with the 95% CI were calculated with the Clopper–Pearson method. PFS and OS with 95% CI were assessed with the Kaplan–Meier method.

canonical_statement: The authors stated that further evidence is required before the efficacy results can be applied to the general population.

canonical_statement: The authors concluded that combining molecular subtyping with targeted sequencing was a promising treatment strategy for refractory metastatic TNBC and should motivate further precision-treatment research.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Overall, the FUTURE trial has shown that the combination of molecular subtyping and targeted sequencing was a promising treatment strategy for refractory metastatic TNBCs. Current findings ... would promote further clinical research on precision treatment of TNBCs.
